title: Void Mage Battle
description: A hooded purple-haired mage leaps dynamically through a chaotic battlefield, dual-wielding glowing purple energy blades that leave light trails. He is surrounded by fallen armored warriors, skulls, demons, ghostly blue spirits, and a massive dark monolith inscribed with runes in the background under a swirling red and black sky.
